question: What will Argentina's country risk (riesgo país, JP Morgan EMBI+) be at the close on October 29, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo anchor: 641-648bp as of Oct 16-19, near the 655 yearly high. Eight trading days remain, and recent realized daily swings of 2-4% imply roughly a 45bp SD. The Oct 25 Brazil runoff is a coin flip (Datafolha 51-49 for Flávio Bolsonaro, PoderData tied, Nexus 46.5-45.9). A Bolsonaro win could repeat the ~80bp relief seen after the first round. A Lula win plus Argentine domestic stress (2027 election parity, recession, Brent $110, UST 5.1%) could push the index past 655-700. The median is shaded slightly below the current level because the index is near its yearly high and partial reversals have followed before. No human market found (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold: none; Polymarket is blocked in Argentina).

calls.reconciliation: The runs agree closely on the evidence and on their numbers. Factual disputes: (1) Oct 19 value 641 vs 648 — cannot settle without web access; Rava's 648 was an early print and 641 came from a search summary. Either way the anchor is ~641-648, and I centred on ~645 before a slight mean-reversion shade. (2) 2026 low 403 (Clarín) vs 473 (question background) — cannot settle; irrelevant to an 8-day horizon. (3) 8 vs 9 trading days left — depends on whether Oct 19 is counted; at most a ~6% difference in SD. (4) Brazil poll figures differ by pollster but all show a near-tie, so this is not material. Judgment: I carry forward the runs' random-walk-plus-Brazil-binary framing and their reference class; my width is the realized-vol computation above, close to Runs 1 and 3. No escape mass declared: below 450 or above 850 within 8 days would need an extreme shock, which I put below 1%.
